```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = NA)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

```{r}
hmc <- housepi::HouseholdModelClass$new("chain-binomial-heterogeneous")
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6, fig.fullwidth=TRUE, out.height="auto", fig.align="center"}
data("survey", package = "housepi")

survey$agegroup <- as.integer(survey$age <= 15)
survey$susgroup <- survey$agegroup
survey$susgroup[(survey$agegroup == 1) & (survey$sex == 1)] <- 2

hmc$add_group_rate("infectivity", by = "agegroup")
hmc$add_group_rate("community_susceptibility", by = "susgroup")
hmc$add_group_rate("susceptibility", by = "susgroup")

hmc$add_template_param()

hmc$infer(survey, progress = FALSE)
lattice::xyplot(hmc$traces)
```
